project.name: ree-v3
project.description: Active V3 implementation substrate for the REE cognitive-architecture research program, written in Python on PyTorch and NumPy. This scan is scoped to the two executable-code planes: ree_core/ (brain-region-named cognitive modules such as amygdala, PFC, hippocampal, sleep, cingulate, PAG, neuromodulation, basal-ganglia action-learning, affect and residue) and coordinator/ (a stdlib http.server coordination service with SQLite storage, a sync daemon and Phase-3 git writers). Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: _sync_to_origin
nodes.summary: Fetches origin and reconciles local writer commits: fast-forwards, rebases writer-authored commits onto refreshed origin, or (for the queue writer only, gated by PHASE3_QUEUE_CONFLICT_RECOVERY) hard-resets and re-materialises from DB on conflict.

nodes.name: _load_runpack_builder
nodes.summary: Late-imports the ree-v3 runpack builder (evidence per-run pack) so the daemon does not carry a hard import dependency on the substrate repo.

nodes.name: _materialize_runpacks
nodes.summary: Materialises evidence per-run manifest/metrics/summary packs from the DB result payload into REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/runs/<run_id>/ before the writer commits them.

nodes.name: _materialize_sidefiles
nodes.summary: Materialises any per-run sidefiles the runner uploaded via the spool (plots, logs) alongside the manifest so a single writer commit lands the whole run pack.

nodes.name: phase3_git_writer
nodes.summary: Sole git writer for evidence manifests in REE_assembly: pulls the spool from the coordinator DB + disk, materialises runpacks and sidefiles, commits with the phase3: prefix, and pushes -- guarded by the active-claim check and the exclusive-telemetry revert.

nodes.name: _canonicalise_queue_item
nodes.summary: Normalises a DB-materialised queue item's field order and defaults so the emitted experiment_queue.json is stable across writer restarts.

nodes.name: _materialise_queue_from_db
nodes.summary: Renders experiment_queue.json from the DB experiments table (active + claimed rows only), used both by the queue writer and by the queue-conflict recovery path.

nodes.name: _warn_on_terminal_drops_without_results
nodes.summary: Emits a warning (never a block) when a queue row goes terminal without a corresponding result row -- the phantom-completion detector at the writer boundary.

nodes.name: phase3_queue_writer
nodes.summary: Sole git writer for ree-v3/experiment_queue.json: computes the target queue from the DB, writes atomically, commits with phase3-queue:, and self-heals rebase conflicts by resetting to origin and re-materialising when PHASE3_QUEUE_CONFLICT_RECOVERY is set.

nodes.name: _atomic_write_text
nodes.summary: Writes text to a temp file, fsyncs, and renames -- used for every writer-produced file so a crash mid-write cannot leave a truncated queue or heartbeat file.

nodes.name: _safe_machine_filename
nodes.summary: Sanitises a machine label into a filesystem-safe filename for the per-machine runner_heartbeats/*.json and runner_status/*.json artifacts.

nodes.name: phase3_heartbeat_writer
nodes.summary: Sole git writer for runner_heartbeats/*.json and runner_status/*.json: commits on state changes only (retired the 30-min forced liveness tick 2026-06-23) to cap git-history bloat, using compute_changes for debouncing.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point: parses SYNC_MODE + --i-understand-phase3, wires up the three writers, and enters the reconcile/writer loop.

nodes.name: lateral_pfc_analog.py
nodes.summary: SD-033a lateral-PFC-analog implementing mid-lateral rule/goal substrate: gate-modulated EMA rule_state persistence driven by MECH-261 SalienceCoordinator write-gates, with trainable rule_bias_head projecting per-candidate score bias into E3.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately documents three design alternatives (per-candidate vs uniform bias, frozen-random vs trained head, gate-modulated EMA vs recurrent GRU) with queued lit-pull tasks; module docstring is a substantial architecture note (~110 lines).

nodes.name: LateralPFCConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass config for SD-033a lateral-PFC analog: rule_dim, update_eta, world_pool_weight, bias_scale, hidden_dim, plus trainable-head, discriminator-source, and readout-consumer knobs.

nodes.name: LateralPFCAnalog
nodes.summary: SD-033a lateral-PFC-analog module: maintains a gate-modulated EMA rule_state buffer updated by z_delta + z_world source, computes per-candidate score bias via clamped rule_bias_head, and supports MECH-261 mode-conditioning, ARC-062 discriminator-source coupling, GAP-D trainable heads, and SD-082 centered/tanh readout amendments.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-trainable rule_state EMA in the default path; when lateral_pfc_train_rule_bias_head is on the last Linear stays random-init so REINFORCE-style updates from the E3 score gradient (via CandidateRuleField or scaffolded REINFORCE loops) can shape the bias head.

nodes.name: salience_coordinator.py
nodes.summary: SD-032a salience-network coordinator: aggregates the dACC bundle plus interoceptive/attention/autonomic signals into a soft operating-mode probability vector, MECH-259 mode-switch trigger, and MECH-261 dict-keyed write-gate registry for downstream consumers.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic Python module (no nn.Module, no learned parameters). Uses dataclass-with-default-factory pattern and defensive property access to preserve backward compatibility across amendments (MECH-266 hysteresis, MECH-048 stability temperature).

nodes.name: SalienceCoordinatorConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass configuration for SalienceCoordinator holding per-mode affinity weights, external-task bias, softmax temperature, switch threshold with stability scaling, MECH-266 per-mode Schmitt-trigger enter/exit thresholds, and MECH-048 mu/kappa temperature-overlay knobs.

nodes.name: SalienceCoordinator
nodes.summary: Network-level coordinator that consumes dACC/AIC/PCC/pACC signals plus drive_level and offline-mode flag, softmaxes per-mode logits into operating_mode probabilities, fires MECH-259 mode-switch triggers under MECH-266 per-mode hysteresis, and exposes MECH-261 write_gate(target) values to downstream substrates.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses torch tensors purely for MECH-048 exponential-temperature scaling; the rest is dict + float arithmetic. Per-episode reset() clears diagnostics but preserves current_mode; setters (set_enter_threshold, set_exit_threshold, set_hysteresis_ratio) allow experiment-time recalibration without rebuild.

nodes.name: anchor_set.py
nodes.summary: Scale-tagged hippocampal anchor store (MECH-269 Phase 2) with dual-trace preservation and hysteresis on V_s_anchor, consuming MECH-288 boundary events to install per-segment anchors.

nodes.name: AnchorGoalPayload
nodes.summary: Immutable dataclass carrying the goal snapshot, wanting strength, arousal tag, and last V_s recorded when an anchor is written.

nodes.name: Anchor
nodes.summary: Represents a single hippocampal anchor keyed by (scale, segment_id, stream_mixture) with V_s tracking, staleness proxy, and active/inactive lifecycle.

nodes.name: AnchorSet
nodes.summary: Container/manager for hippocampal anchors: installs anchors on boundary events, marks inactive on remap under hysteresis, and exposes lookup/iteration APIs.

nodes.name: event_segmenter.py
nodes.summary: MECH-288 per-tick hierarchical event boundary detector emitting monotonic outer.inner segment IDs; combines PE-threshold (fast) and BOCPD-Gaussian (slow) detectors with per-stream isolation.

nodes.name: BoundaryEvent
nodes.summary: Lightweight dataclass describing a single detected event boundary (scale, segment_id, stream) emitted by the segmenter.

nodes.name: BoundaryQueryResult
nodes.summary: Structured query result describing recent boundary firings and current segment identifiers per scale and stream.

nodes.name: Scale
nodes.summary: Descriptor for one segmentation scale (fast/slow), naming its detector type and input signals.

nodes.name: _PEThresholdDetector
nodes.summary: Fast-scale boundary detector using a sliding z-score of prediction error over z_world + z_self; fires when normalized PE exceeds threshold.

nodes.name: _BOCPDGaussianDetector
nodes.summary: Slow-scale Bayesian Online Change Point Detection detector on z_goal, using Gaussian likelihoods and top-k run-length posterior pruning.

nodes.name: EventSegmenter
nodes.summary: Top-level segmenter maintaining per-stream detectors and monotonic segment counters; exposes step/force_boundary/boundary_on APIs to downstream substrates.

nodes.name: ghost_goal_bank.py
nodes.summary: MECH-292 derived ranking view over the SD-039 anchor pool: scores anchors on a wanting+goal_match+staleness+recoverability composite and returns a sorted ghost-goal bank.

nodes.name: PersistenceAppraisal
nodes.summary: Small dataclass carrying appraisal scalars (persistence probability, decisiveness) computed by the persistence-appraisal compute module and consumed here.

nodes.name: GhostGoalBankEntry
nodes.summary: A ranked entry in the ghost-goal bank pairing an anchor with its composite score and per-term breakdown.

nodes.name: GhostGoalBank
nodes.summary: Computes the composite ghost-goal ranking with an outshining-gated context cue (MECH-339 Constraint 1), producing a sorted bank of retrieval candidates.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel package for policy-layer substrates that re-exports gated/candidate-rule/curiosity/vigor/noise-floor/commit-maintenance regulators for import by REEAgent and experiments.

nodes.name: candidate_rule_field.py
nodes.summary: ARC-063 distributed CandidateRule field substrate: non-Bayesian rule creator that mints structurally-differentiated pinned-direction rules on recurring context/action patterns, gates by tolerance-conflict threshold, and credits availability via eligibility traces for SD-033a lateral_pfc rule_state consumption.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic regulator (no nn.Module, no learned parameters); uses cross-episode persistence, mature-pool dynamics, and availability-maintenance flags via a config dataclass.

nodes.name: CandidateRuleFieldConfig
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass carrying the 30+ tunable knobs for the CandidateRuleField substrate: slot count, mint thresholds, availability decay, tolerance-conflict gain, mature-pool dynamics, maintenance floor, cue-centering (SD-078), and cross-episode persistence.

nodes.name: CandidateRule
nodes.summary: Dataclass unit representing a single minted rule slot: pinned-direction rule_embedding, context_tag, availability, eligibility trace, minted/last-active step, active flag, and optional action_object_idx.

nodes.name: CandidateRuleField
nodes.summary: Main field substrate implementing MECH-349 CREATE (context-bucket recurrence mint), MECH-350 REPRESENT (pinned-orthogonal directions), MECH-351 GATE (tolerance-conflict admission), MECH-338 SELECT (cosine retrieval), and MECH-352 CREDIT (eligibility-trace availability updates) with cue-centering baseline (SD-078) and maintenance-hold semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Twenty methods orchestrate mint/gate/select/credit cycles; per-step baseline EMA for common-mode invariance; MECH-094 simulation_mode gate on all state-advancing methods.

nodes.name: self_model_aggregator.py
nodes.summary: MECH-273 Phase E self-model writeback substrate: subclass of the MECH-275 BayesianAggregator specialised on the SD-003 causal_sig posterior in the 'self' domain, running bounded low-LR offline gradient passes on E2_harm_s (ARC-033) parameters using aggregator-corrected residuals as training targets. Constitutes the sleep-cluster's single explicit exception to MECH-094's no-parameter-writes-in-simulation-mode rule, scoped to E2_harm_s only.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dataclass inheritance to extend the parent Bayesian aggregator config; guards optional torch/E2HarmSForward imports behind TYPE_CHECKING to avoid runtime coupling.

nodes.name: SelfModelAggregatorConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass extending BayesianAggregatorConfig with Phase E specific knobs: 'self' domain default, offline learning-rate scale (default 0.1), bounded step count (default 100), and an optional stdlib-random seed for reproducibility. Validates that offline_lr_scale is non-negative.

nodes.name: SelfModelAggregator
nodes.summary: Self-domain Bayesian aggregator that adds an offline gradient-pass writeback surface on top of the inherited posterior update / snapshot / decay contract. During Phase E it iterates over live 'self' posteriors (or the SWS-only last_snapshot) and runs a bounded MSE gradient descent on E2_harm_s parameters, drawing (z_harm_s, action) pairs from a waking harm-replay buffer with a synthetic fallback.

nodes.name: offline_gradient_pass
nodes.summary: Runs the MECH-273 Phase E writeback: constructs training targets from the aggregator posterior means at each replayed region, samples (z_harm_s, action) input pairs from the harm replay buffer (or a synthetic zeros + round-robin one-hot fallback), and takes n_steps bounded Adam steps on E2_harm_s parameters at an offline-scaled learning rate.

nodes.name: get_metrics
nodes.summary: Extends the parent aggregator metrics dict with Phase E specific diagnostics: cumulative offline pass count, total steps, cumulative loss, most recent loss, and the number of regions consumed by the last writeback.

nodes.name: PHASE3_CUTOVER.md
nodes.summary: Plan-of-record documentation for the Phase 3 result-cutover in the ree-v3 coordinator, covering env knobs, writer behaviour, preconditions checklist, operator cutover procedure, rollback plan, tooling map, and post-cutover verification.

nodes.name: phase3_preflight.py
nodes.summary: Phase 3 cutover pre-flight verification tool: runs 20+ SSH/HTTP/DB checks over the coordinator fleet (hub + 4 cloud workers + Mac) and returns exit codes 0/1/2 based on aggregate PASS/FAIL/CONFIG status. Includes fleet-lifecycle evaluation with graceful-offline tolerance for scaler workers.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure standard-library Python with dataclass-driven CheckResult accumulation and structured JSON/text reporting; deliberately ASCII-only stdout per project convention.

nodes.name: CheckResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass aggregating a single preflight check's outcome: check_id, category, status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/WARN), message, and structured detail dict.

nodes.name: _ssh_run
nodes.summary: Runs a shell command on a remote host over SSH with BatchMode and configurable timeout; returns (rc, stdout, stderr) with graceful error capture on subprocess or network failure.

nodes.name: _import_sync_daemon_ready
nodes.summary: Dynamically loads coordinator/sync_daemon.py as a module (bypassing package import to avoid dependency chain) and verifies the phase3_gates_ready function exists and returns truthy.

nodes.name: _evaluate_fleet_lifecycle
nodes.summary: Evaluates fleet-lifecycle state from a /shadow/status payload: verifies expected peers are heartbeating, accepts gracefully_offline ONLY outside cutover windows and only for scaler-managed workers (ree-cloud-4 by default).

nodes.name: run_preflight
nodes.summary: Main preflight orchestrator: loads env, validates 20+ conditions across hub SSH, coordinator HTTP endpoints (/health, /queue/snapshot, /shadow/status), SQLite schema, sync_daemon gates, git-tree cleanliness, and per-worker peer status; returns list of CheckResult.

nodes.name: _summary
nodes.summary: Aggregates a list of CheckResult objects into a summary dict with total, per-status counts, per-category rollup, and derived overall pass boolean.

nodes.name: _print_report
nodes.summary: Prints an ASCII-safe human-readable report of preflight results, grouping by status with per-check message and category label.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entrypoint: parses argparse arguments (--dry-run, --json, --env-file, --cutover-window), invokes run_preflight, and returns exit code 0 (all PASS), 1 (any FAIL), or 2 (config error).

nodes.name: test_phase3_claim_atomic_write.py
nodes.summary: Tests the 2026-05-28 cutover-fix companion bugs in experiment_runner: (1) legacy claim push gating under PHASE3_DISABLE_RUNNER_QUEUE_PUSH so no git commits fire, (2) atomic queue-file write using tmp+os.replace so concurrent readers never see partial JSON.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses phase3_git_probe helper to intercept subprocess.run and internal _git_run soft-timeout helper — a bare patch.object on subprocess.run alone would pass vacuously.

nodes.name: Phase3GateClaimPush
nodes.summary: Verifies that with PHASE3_DISABLE_RUNNER_QUEUE_PUSH=1 the runner's attempt_claim and release_claim functions update the local queue file (claimed_by populated/cleared) but invoke ZERO git subprocess calls.

nodes.name: AtomicQueueWrite
nodes.summary: Verifies _atomic_write_queue writes via a temp file replaced atomically with os.replace: readers only see the old or new file, never a partial write mid-flight (fixes cloud-2's git-conflict-marker JSON decoder crash from 2026-05-28).

nodes.name: test_phase3_preflight.py
nodes.summary: Smoke tests for phase3_preflight.py that run without a live hub: covers --help, --json mode structure, local-mode dry-run checks, cutover-window flag, pure _evaluate_fleet_lifecycle logic, and live-mode COORDINATOR_URL requirement.

nodes.name: _hermetic_env
nodes.summary: Builds an environment dict with every COORDINATOR_URL/TOKEN/ENV_FILE variable stripped, preventing tests from accidentally hitting the live hub via os.environ fallback in run_preflight.

nodes.name: test_help_exits_zero
nodes.summary: Verifies phase3_preflight.py --help exits with return code 0.

nodes.name: test_mock_json_all_pass_structure
nodes.summary: Runs preflight in dry-run + JSON mode with a minimal env and asserts the output has the expected top-level keys (results, summary, overall_pass).

nodes.name: test_dry_run_local_checks
nodes.summary: Comprehensive dry-run test: writes a minimal env file, runs preflight, and asserts the emitted checks cover local schema, sync_daemon, and other local-only categories with structured status fields.

nodes.name: test_cutover_window_flag_accepted
nodes.summary: Verifies the --cutover-window CLI flag is accepted and propagates through to the fleet-lifecycle evaluation logic.

nodes.name: test_evaluate_fleet_lifecycle_pure
nodes.summary: Unit tests the pure _evaluate_fleet_lifecycle function against synthetic /shadow/status payloads: verifies PASS on all-heartbeating, FAIL on missing peers, and cutover-window vs graceful-offline behavior.

nodes.name: test_local_modes_do_not_need_coordinator_env
nodes.summary: Verifies that --dry-run and other local-only modes succeed when COORDINATOR_URL/TOKEN are absent, ensuring local checks work in a stripped hermetic environment.

nodes.name: test_live_mode_still_fails_without_url
nodes.summary: Verifies live-mode preflight (no --dry-run) exits with configuration-error code 2 when COORDINATOR_URL is missing rather than silently passing.

nodes.name: test_phase3_runner_gates.py
nodes.summary: Contract tests for four Phase 3 runner-push gating env flags (PHASE3_DISABLE_RUNNER_{RESULT,QUEUE,HEARTBEAT,CLAIM}_PUSH): asserts each gate is a true no-op via phase3_git_probe, which patches both the soft-timeout git helper and subprocess.run.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses phase3_git_probe rather than bare patch.object(subprocess, 'run') — after b0a6dd8 every git call routes through the soft-timeout helper into graceful_timeout, which reaches stdlib directly, so subprocess-only patches vacuously pass every assertion.

nodes.name: GatesEnvOff
nodes.summary: Baseline test: with all PHASE3 gate flags unset, git push functions invoke subprocess/git calls as expected (positive control ensuring the probe correctly detects git invocations).

nodes.name: ResultPushGate
nodes.summary: Verifies PHASE3_DISABLE_RUNNER_RESULT_PUSH=1 makes git_push_results a total no-op: zero git subprocess calls, zero commits, per-experiment results are not pushed by the runner.

nodes.name: QueuePushGate
nodes.summary: Verifies PHASE3_DISABLE_RUNNER_QUEUE_PUSH=1 makes git_push_queue a no-op: zero git calls to push the experiment_queue.json snapshot to ree-v3 main.

nodes.name: StatusPushGate
nodes.summary: Verifies PHASE3_DISABLE_RUNNER_HEARTBEAT_PUSH=1 also gates git_push_status (heartbeats and status land via the same sync_daemon step 6 in Phase 3).

nodes.name: HeartbeatAndCommandsGate
nodes.summary: Verifies PHASE3_DISABLE_RUNNER_HEARTBEAT_PUSH=1 makes runner_remote_control.push_heartbeat and push_commands total no-ops with zero git subprocess invocations.

nodes.name: ClaimPushGate
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test of PHASE3_DISABLE_RUNNER_CLAIM_PUSH=1: verifies attempt_claim and release_claim skip all `claim: V3-EXQ-XXX -> <machine>` commits (coordinator /claim is the authoritative Phase 3 arbiter). Nine test methods cover forward/reverse claim scenarios, edge cases, and diagnostic messages.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Stdlib HTTP coordinator server that arbitrates queue claims, ingests result manifests/heartbeats/status/shutdown notices from fleet workers, and exposes shadow/health endpoints; the single Phase-3 authority for claim mutex and telemetry.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler with a per-connection lock; every route dispatches through one Handler class (do_GET/do_POST).

nodes.name: Handler
nodes.summary: BaseHTTPRequestHandler subclass implementing every coordinator route -- /claim, /release, /result, /heartbeat, /status, /shutdown_notify, /clear_claim_fence, /queue/add, /command, and /shadow/* -- with bearer-token auth and JSON responses.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entrypoint that initializes the SQLite DB, loads bearer tokens, and starts the ThreadingHTTPServer bound to COORDINATOR_HOST:PORT.

nodes.name: auth_machine
nodes.summary: Parses a Bearer authorization header and returns the machine identity matching the shared-secret token, or None when the token is unknown.

nodes.name: _read_writer_health
nodes.summary: Reads and JSON-parses the sync_daemon writer-health snapshot file, returning an empty dict when the file is missing or malformed.

nodes.name: _age_out_errors
nodes.summary: Filters a writer-health snapshot to drop recent-errors older than cutoff_iso so /writer-health reports only live incidents.

nodes.name: db.py
nodes.summary: SQLite persistence + business logic for the Phase-3 coordinator: schema migrations, queue and claim state machine (try_claim, release, fence, departure-based recovery), heartbeat/status/shutdown ingest, and per-machine command channel.
nodes.languageNotes: All writes wrap with BEGIN IMMEDIATE for serialised claim arbitration; migrations are idempotent ALTER TABLE guards keyed on PRAGMA table_info.

nodes.name: init_db
nodes.summary: Runs every schema migration (experiments, heartbeats, commands) in one connection so a fresh or upgraded DB reaches the current schema in one call.

nodes.name: _migrate_experiments
nodes.summary: Creates the experiments table (queue rows with claim state) and adds later columns via idempotent ALTER TABLE guards.

nodes.name: _migrate_heartbeats
nodes.summary: Creates the heartbeats table and progressively adds shutdown/telemetry columns (last_shutdown_at, claim_fence_cleared_at, last_process_exit_at, shutdown_reason) so old DBs converge to current shape.

nodes.name: _migrate_commands
nodes.summary: Creates the commands table (per-machine command channel: pause/resume/stop/kick/etc.) and indexes it by machine for fast polling.

nodes.name: upsert_experiment
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a queue item from the source-of-truth queue JSON, honouring preserve_claim so a running claim is not accidentally reset by reconciler ticks.

nodes.name: _has_fresh_owner_heartbeat
nodes.summary: Returns True when the machine holding a claim has heartbeated within the fresh-window, guarding against reaping a claim whose owner is actually still alive.

nodes.name: _claim_recoverable
nodes.summary: Decides whether a stale claim may be reaped, combining the age-based rule (older than STALE_HOURS with no fresh owner heartbeat) with the departure route (announced-shutdown owner gone quiet for reap_quiet_seconds).

nodes.name: claim_fence_active
nodes.summary: Pure predicate that says whether a machine currently sits inside its post-shutdown claim fence, excluding process-exit reasons and honouring the fence-cleared timestamp with a strict tie-break.

nodes.name: machine_claim_fenced
nodes.summary: DB-backed wrapper around claim_fence_active that reads the heartbeats row for a machine and returns whether new claims should be refused.

nodes.name: record_claim_fence_clear
nodes.summary: Stamps claim_fence_cleared_at on a machine's heartbeat row (creating it if absent) so the fence disarms after a fresh poweron.

nodes.name: machine_departed
nodes.summary: Pure predicate answering whether a machine has announced a genuine shutdown (not a process exit) and stayed quiet for quiet_seconds since, so claims it still owns can be reaped early.

nodes.name: machine_has_departed
nodes.summary: DB wrapper for machine_departed that reads the machine's heartbeat row and answers the departure question.

nodes.name: claim_orphaned_by_departure
nodes.summary: Composite check that a queue row's owner has departed, gating the fast recovery path so an orphan claim can be released within minutes rather than 6 hours.

nodes.name: try_claim
nodes.summary: Atomic claim arbitration: under BEGIN IMMEDIATE, resolves affinity, fence, stale-recovery and departure-recovery, then either stamps the claim to the requesting machine or refuses with a reason code.

nodes.name: evaluate_claim
nodes.summary: Read-only sibling of try_claim used by /evaluate_claim: returns the same verdict without mutating rows, for the dry-run comparison path against the legacy git mutex.

nodes.name: apply_git_outcome
nodes.summary: Records the outcome the legacy git-push claim mutex reported for a queue_id, used to compute divergence stats between the two authorities during shadow mode.

nodes.name: release_claim
nodes.summary: Releases a machine's own claim on a queue_id and moves the row back to unclaimed, refusing to release someone else's claim.

nodes.name: mark_queue_removed
nodes.summary: Marks a queue item as removed with a reason (typically because the source queue JSON no longer names it), preserving history rather than deleting the row.

nodes.name: claim_verdicts_diverge
nodes.summary: Compares the coordinator claim verdict to the git-mutex verdict for the same queue_id and returns whether they diverge in a way that is not explained by machine ordering.

nodes.name: divergence_stats
nodes.summary: Aggregates counts of claim-verdict divergences (agree, git-only, coordinator-only, both-different) for the shadow-mode dashboard.

nodes.name: log_claim
nodes.summary: Appends a claim event row (both verdicts + detail) to the claims audit table for later divergence analysis.

nodes.name: record_result
nodes.summary: Persists a fleet worker's result manifest (outcome + bytes + sha) keyed on run_id/queue_id/machine so the sync_daemon writer can pick it up.

nodes.name: upsert_heartbeat
nodes.summary: Merges a fleet heartbeat into the heartbeats table -- state/current_exq/progress/gpu/timing plus the full payload JSON -- creating the row on first sight and preserving any prior shutdown timestamps.

nodes.name: record_status_payload
nodes.summary: Stores a per-machine status payload (queue depth, GPU details) as JSON on the heartbeats row so /shadow/status can render fleet-wide.

nodes.name: record_shutdown_notice
nodes.summary: Stores a machine shutdown notice, distinguishing genuine machine shutdowns (arm the claim fence) from process exits (do not arm), preserving last_seen and enforcing exact-field write semantics.

nodes.name: announced_offline_at
nodes.summary: Returns the later of a machine's last_shutdown_at and last_process_exit_at (both optional, both may be malformed), used by lifecycle reporting.

nodes.name: lifecycle_state
nodes.summary: Classifies a machine as live / gracefully_offline / stale based on heartbeat freshness and whether an announced shutdown is the most recent event, so /shadow/status can label boxes.

nodes.name: insert_command
nodes.summary: Enqueues a per-machine command (pause/resume/stop/kick/release_claim) with issuer attribution, returning the new command_id.

nodes.name: fetch_pending_commands
nodes.summary: Returns the machine's un-acked commands so the runner poll can drain them in FIFO order.

nodes.name: ack_command
nodes.summary: Marks a command acked with result_status/result_note, refusing an ack from a machine other than the addressee so misdirected acks cannot silently clear another box's queue.

nodes.name: get_queue_status
nodes.summary: Returns aggregate queue counts (pending / claimed / done / errored) for the coordinator's shadow status endpoint.

nodes.name: test_shutdown_notify.py
nodes.summary: Time-independent unittest suite covering the shutdown-notify / claim-fence / lifecycle path in db.py plus its HTTP surface in app.py, including end-to-end replays of the drain-window incident that motivated the fence.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses unittest with tmpdir SQLite DBs and free-port live HTTP servers; injects `now` to keep every predicate deterministic.

nodes.name: LifecycleStateTest
nodes.summary: Exercises db.lifecycle_state -- live/gracefully_offline/stale transitions, boundary conditions at the live-threshold, and malformed-timestamp handling.

nodes.name: ShutdownNoticeDBTest
nodes.summary: Tests db.record_shutdown_notice at the DB layer: creates the row if absent, idempotently overwrites, preserves last_seen, and accepts optional reason/wake fields.

nodes.name: ShutdownNotifyHTTPTest
nodes.summary: End-to-end HTTP tests for POST /shutdown_notify: auth required, explicit machine field required, non-empty JSON body required, and the client-side coordinator_client is disabled in git-mode.

nodes.name: ClaimFenceStateTest
nodes.summary: Pure-predicate tests for db.claim_fence_active including the 8-minute-into-drain incident replay, fence expiry, clear semantics, tie-break at the same second, and the process-exit exclusion.

nodes.name: ClaimFenceDBTest
nodes.summary: DB-level tests for the claim fence: unfenced machines still claim, fenced ones are refused without mutation, the fence is machine-scoped, survives a fresh heartbeat, and clear is idempotent.

nodes.name: ClaimFenceHTTPTest
nodes.summary: HTTP-level claim-fence tests: /claim refuses in the fence window, /shadow/status surfaces the fenced state, /clear_claim_fence disarms, and process exits do not disarm end-to-end.

nodes.name: ScalerClearFenceWiringTest
nodes.summary: Pins the wiring between the cloud-scaler and the /clear_claim_fence endpoint: every poweron call site must invoke the clear script, and a missing script must not break poweron.

nodes.name: AnnouncedOfflineAtTest
nodes.summary: Covers db.announced_offline_at across every combination of shutdown/process-exit timestamps (missing, one, both, malformed), pinning the max-with-parse-guards semantics.

nodes.name: ProcessExitDoesNotDisarmFenceTest
nodes.summary: Guards the invariant that a runner process exit is stored separately from a machine shutdown and never disarms the fence -- includes the measured incident replay, legacy-row compatibility, and the migration adding the split columns.

nodes.name: _http
nodes.summary: Test helper that issues an authenticated JSON HTTP request against the live coordinator and returns (status_code, parsed_json).

nodes.name: agent.py
nodes.summary: Master REE V3 agent (9556 lines, ~94-method REEAgent class) integrating LatentStack, E1/E2/E3 predictors, HippocampalModule, ResidueField, cingulate cluster, amygdala, PAG, neuromodulation, sleep, and safety modules through the SENSE -> E1 tick -> E2 tick -> E3 tick -> SELECT -> ACT -> RESIDUE -> REPLAY -> OFFLINE loop.
nodes.languageNotes: Python file dominated by a single monolithic class (REEAgent) that couples every V3 subsystem; 43 project-internal imports and a ~2715-entry internal call graph.

nodes.name: stack.py
nodes.summary: SD-005 split latent-space (L-space) implementation: z_self vs z_world encoders, harm-stream encoders (SD-010/SD-011), reafference predictor (SD-007), harm forward models (ARC-033/ARC-058), adversarial split head, and the LatentStack module gluing them into the shared z_beta/z_theta/z_delta context.
nodes.languageNotes: PyTorch nn.Module implementations with an autograd-Function gradient-reversal layer; 15 exported classes are the atomic pieces of the SD-005 encoder split.

nodes.name: candidate_support_preflight
nodes.summary: Module-level SP-CEM support-preserving preflight over a candidate list plus optional forced score bias, used to compute the surviving candidate support that E3 selection consumes.

nodes.name: _resolve_chunk_deliberation_horizon
nodes.summary: Resolves the ARC-071 chunk-deliberation horizon from REEConfig: honours an explicit override, otherwise mirrors HippocampalConfig.horizon, with a stdlib default fallback.

nodes.name: AgentState
nodes.summary: Small dataclass holding the current LatentState, GoalState, and simple per-tick agent-level counters passed to consumers that need a compact snapshot rather than the full REEAgent surface.

nodes.name: REEAgent
nodes.summary: The monolithic V3 agent class: owns every subsystem (LatentStack, E1/E2/E3 predictors, HippocampalModule, ResidueField, cingulate cluster, amygdala BLA/CeA, PAG freeze-gate, neuromodulators, sleep loop, coalition controller, dozens of substrate regulators), sequences the SD-006 multi-rate loop, and exposes sense/select/act/update/reset/replay/sleep APIs.
nodes.languageNotes: ~94 methods, ~9200 lines of class body; the top-level composition site for essentially every V3 SD/MECH landing.

nodes.name: REEAgent.from_config
nodes.summary: Classmethod factory that constructs a fully-wired REEAgent from a REEConfig, handling substrate flag preconditions and optional subsystem construction.

nodes.name: REEAgent.reset
nodes.summary: Per-episode reset: clears LatentState/GoalState traces, resets regulators (SD-036 decay, PAG freeze-gate, coalition controller, natural-commit latch), and rewinds within-episode substrate state while preserving cross-episode learned parameters.

nodes.name: REEAgent.sense
nodes.summary: Perceptual entry point: routes body/world/harm observations through LatentStack.encode, applies SD-036 GABAergic decay, MECH-269 V_s updates, MECH-288 boundary segmentation, MECH-287 broadcast trigger, SD-035 amygdala, MECH-353 blocked-agency, MECH-357 avoidance-gate updates, and MECH-219 suffering integration.

nodes.name: REEAgent.sense_flat
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper accepting a flat obs vector, splitting it into body/world/harm channels and delegating to sense().

nodes.name: REEAgent._e1_tick
nodes.summary: Fires the E1 deep predictor: updates the shared latent stack, extracts SD-016 cue context, caches schema salience, and pushes z_self/z_world into the ThetaBuffer / MultiContentThetaPacket at every waking tick.

nodes.name: REEAgent._e3_tick
nodes.summary: Fires the E3 tick at the multi-rate clock boundary: builds candidate trajectories via HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories, applies ARC-070 policy decomposition, and seals the MECH-294 multi-content theta packet.

nodes.name: REEAgent.generate_trajectories
nodes.summary: Delegates to HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories with agent-side context (ARC-071 chunk source, ARC-070 decomposition source, current z_goal), returning the candidate pool that E3 will score.

nodes.name: REEAgent.select_action
nodes.summary: The central action-selection routine: composes the dACC/lPFC/OFC/MECH-295/MECH-314/MECH-320/MECH-353/MECH-357/MECH-358 bias chain, runs the MECH-448 F-eligibility envelope + MECH-449 Go/No-Go + ARC-108 learned gating + ARC-110 loop segregation, applies coalition gates, and returns the committed action.

nodes.name: REEAgent._assemble_control_vector
nodes.summary: Assembles the read-only four-signal control-vector telemetry (V_outcome / C_effort / C_time / G_vigor) exposed via _last_control_vector for inspection tooling.

nodes.name: REEAgent.act
nodes.summary: Public act API: runs sense_flat + select_action and returns the emitted action (thin loop-composition wrapper for step-once callers).

nodes.name: REEAgent.act_with_split_obs
nodes.summary: Split-observation variant of act() used by drivers that supply body/world observations separately.

nodes.name: REEAgent.act_with_log_prob
nodes.summary: Act variant that also returns the selected action's log-probability, used by policy-gradient training paths (SD-033a/b bias-head REINFORCE, ARC-108 actor-critic).

nodes.name: REEAgent.update_z_goal
nodes.summary: Drives the goal-pipeline update: seeds GoalState from z_resource or SD-057 IncentiveTokenBank, applies MECH-295 liking bridge writes, SD-024 benefit-terrain producer, MECH-189 super-ordinal anchor writes/reads, and MECH-426 progress-velocity recording.

nodes.name: REEAgent.update_residue
nodes.summary: Accumulates world_delta into the ResidueField (MECH-094 hypothesis_tag gated), fires MECH-205 surprise-gated valence writes, runs ARC-108 JOB-2 habenula tick, and MECH-290 backward-credit sweeps.

nodes.name: REEAgent.record_transition
nodes.summary: Records a completed environment transition into the training buffers (world experience, harm buffer, chunk accumulator, exploration buffer, cross-stream binder pairs).

nodes.name: REEAgent.notify_env_completion
nodes.summary: SD-034 Leg-A hook routing env transition_type=='sequence_complete' into the ClosureOperator.emit_closure entrypoint (waking, non-simulation only).

nodes.name: REEAgent.notify_subgoal_attainment
nodes.summary: SD-092 explicit hook: on a subgoal-attainment env transition, credits the GoalState._z_goal_parent EMA with a caller-supplied child representation (mirrors the notify_env_completion convention).

nodes.name: REEAgent.actor_critic_step
nodes.summary: MECH-457 first-class actor-critic step: encodes z_world (cotrain or detach per SD-070 lever), forwards ActorCriticPolicy, and returns the selected action + value logits for the RL trainer.

nodes.name: REEAgent.actor_critic_reward
nodes.summary: Computes the substrate RPE teacher R_t = detach(e3.benefit_eval - e3.harm_eval) at a realised state for the actor-critic value target (ARC-108 signed RPE source).

nodes.name: REEAgent._do_replay
nodes.summary: MECH-092 quiescent replay: fires HippocampalModule.replay / diverse_replay under hypothesis_tag=True (MECH-094 sim-mode) with mode routing (auto/forward/reverse) and optional drive-state weighting.

nodes.name: REEAgent.enter_sws_mode
nodes.summary: Enters SD-017 SWS phase: sets offline mode, applies MECH-120 SHY normalisation, notifies PCC offline-entry hook, and holds SerotoninModule tonic_5ht.

nodes.name: REEAgent.enter_rem_mode
nodes.summary: Enters SD-017 REM phase: drops tonic_5ht to 0 (MECH-204 zero-point capture), records precision-at-REM-entry, and prepares for the attribution replay pass.

nodes.name: REEAgent.exit_sleep_mode
nodes.summary: Restores waking mode: clears offline flag, applies MECH-122 spindle content packaging summary, and resets sleep-phase counters.

nodes.name: REEAgent.run_sws_schema_pass
nodes.summary: SD-017 SWS-analog schema installation: samples prototype vectors from the world experience buffer, optionally spindle-selected under MECH-122, and writes to ContextMemory bypassing the offline gate.

nodes.name: REEAgent.run_rem_attribution_pass
nodes.summary: SD-017 REM-analog attribution pass: replays theta buffer content via hippocampal forward/reverse replay, evaluates residue terrain (hypothesis_tag=True), and applies MECH-217 offline wanting-spread on the reverse branch.

nodes.name: REEAgent.run_sleep_cycle
nodes.summary: Convenience method: enters SWS -> runs schema pass -> exits -> enters REM -> runs attribution pass -> exits, returning merged sleep-cycle metrics.

nodes.name: REEAgent.cue_recall_wanting
nodes.summary: SD-057 L6 cue-recall primitive: retrieves an IncentiveTokenBank token by cue type and cue_pulls z_goal toward the stored object embedding proportional to drive-scaled wanting.

nodes.name: REEAgent.update_object_file_buffer
nodes.summary: ARC-006 / MECH-045 object-file buffer update entrypoint: forwards perceived entities to ObjectFileBuffer.update on the waking stream (MECH-094 gated), tracking token persistence across motion.

nodes.name: REEAgent.cross_stream_binder
nodes.summary: Accessor for the cross_stream_binding_substrate CrossStreamBinder (learned or fixed) instance owned by E2FastPredictor, used by drivers that want to inspect or train the binder directly.

nodes.name: REEAgent.serotonin_step
nodes.summary: MECH-203 SerotoninModule tick: advances tonic_5ht based on benefit_exposure and z_harm_a, and dynamically modulates GoalConfig gains for downstream consumers.

nodes.name: REEAgent.update_benefit_salience
nodes.summary: SR-2 write path: writes tonic_5ht-scaled benefit_salience into SD-014 VALENCE_WANTING at the current z_world (optionally routed through SD-024 accumulate_benefit when the live producer is armed).

nodes.name: REEAgent.update_harm_salience
nodes.summary: MECH-203 SR-2 harm-symmetric write: mirrors update_benefit_salience for VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE using calibrated EMA'd harm_exposure to avoid RBF-field swamping.

nodes.name: REEAgent.update_liking
nodes.summary: SD-014 VALENCE_LIKING write path at resource contact (Berridge hedonic-impact analog); the consummatory pole complementing the anticipatory VALENCE_WANTING channel.

nodes.name: REEAgent.forward
nodes.summary: nn.Module forward pass exposing agent as a torch module for gradient plumbing where callers require it (mostly training utilities).

nodes.name: REEAgent.get_state
nodes.summary: Aggregates a diagnostics snapshot from every wired regulator (beta_gate, BLA/CeA, SD-036 decay, SD-037 override, MECH-450 W_lat, ARC-108 gating, coalition controller, ...) into a single dict for manifest/telemetry consumption.

nodes.name: ReafferencePredictor
nodes.summary: SD-007/MECH-098/MECH-101 perspective-shift corrector: predicts the z_world delta from self-motion (given z_world_raw_prev + a_prev) and subtracts it to yield perspective-corrected z_world (MSTd congruent/incongruent analog).

nodes.name: HarmEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-010 sensory-discriminative nociceptive encoder (A-delta analog): maps raw harm_obs -> z_harm_s used by E3.harm_eval_z_harm_head and E2HarmSForward.

nodes.name: AffectiveHarmEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-011 affective-motivational harm encoder (C-fiber analog): consumes harm_obs_a EMA + optional harm_history and produces z_harm_a plus an auxiliary harm_accum_pred head (SD-011 second-source + SD-020 surprise-PE target).

nodes.name: ResourceEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-015/SD-049-Phase-2 z_resource encoder plus the SD-049 identity-classifier head (Option-C hybrid): produces z_resource + resource_prox_pred_r + optional identity_logits for the goal-pipeline seeding path.

nodes.name: HarmForwardModel
nodes.summary: Simple MLP forward model f(z_harm, a) -> z_harm_pred_next used as the naive baseline against which the residual and shared-trunk harm forward models are compared.

nodes.name: HarmForwardTrunk
nodes.summary: ARC-058 shared PE trunk (unsigned, modality-independent): produces the shared hidden representation consumed by per-stream HarmForwardHead readouts (anterior insula PE hub analog).

nodes.name: HarmForwardHead
nodes.summary: ARC-058 stream-specific (signed) harm-forward head consumed by E2HarmSForward or E2HarmAForward when the shared-trunk configuration is selected.

nodes.name: ResidualHarmForward
nodes.summary: Residual delta-architecture forward model used by ARC-033 E2HarmSForward and SD-031 E2WorldForward: predicts a small delta on top of the identity, avoiding autocorrelated identity collapse.

nodes.name: HarmBridge
nodes.summary: Deprecated z_world -> z_harm bridge preserved for historical / ablation purposes; superseded by SD-010's direct HarmEncoder because bridge_r2 was architecturally zero.

nodes.name: _GradReverseFn
nodes.summary: torch.autograd.Function implementing the gradient-reversal layer used by AdversarialSplitHead (identity forward, negated gradient backward).

nodes.name: AdversarialSplitHead
nodes.summary: Adversarial head enforcing z_self/z_world separability via gradient reversal: penalises cross-stream information leakage during joint encoder training.

nodes.name: LatentState
nodes.summary: Immutable-ish dataclass holding the SD-005 split latent tuple (z_self, z_world) plus shared channels (z_beta/z_theta/z_delta), auxiliary predictions (resource proximity, harm accumulator), and post-SD-013 optional harm channels (z_harm, z_harm_a, z_harm_un, z_block, z_harm_suffering).

nodes.name: SplitEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-005 bottom-of-stack encoder: routes body/world observation channels through independent MLPs for z_self and z_world, with SD-018 resource-proximity head, top-down z_beta/z_delta conditioning, and shared trunk options.

nodes.name: SharedDepthEncoder
nodes.summary: Shared-depth encoder variant for ablations that couple the z_self/z_world encoders beyond the SD-005 split, retained as a controlled experimental knob.

nodes.name: LatentStack
nodes.summary: Top-level nn.Module orchestrator of the SD-005 L-space: builds encoders (SplitEncoder or SharedDepthEncoder), harm encoders (SD-010/SD-011), ReafferencePredictor (SD-007), ResourceEncoder (SD-015/SD-049), the DR-13 SelfRecurrenceCell, MECH-267 mode-noise/horizon scale, GABA harm-state recurrence (SD-036), and exposes encode/predict/compute_prediction_error/modulate_precision APIs.

nodes.name: ofc_analog.py
nodes.summary: Orbitofrontal-cortex analog module (SD-033b) providing state-code EMA and score-bias heads that inject candidate ranking bias into E3 trajectory selection, with a separate devaluation bias head decoupled from the primary discrimination head.
nodes.languageNotes: PyTorch nn.Module with register_buffer state and zeroed last-Linear inits for bit-identical OFF defaults.

nodes.name: OFCConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass configuration for OFCAnalog controlling state dim, update rate, outcome pool weight, bias scale, and gates for the state-bias head, devaluation head, and oracle usage.

nodes.name: OFCAnalog
nodes.summary: PFC-subdivision OFC analog nn.Module: maintains a per-tick EMA state code over z_world and optional z_harm, then emits per-candidate score biases via a state-bias head and an optional decoupled devaluation-bias head consumed by E3 selection.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Constructs projection layers, state and devaluation bias-head MLPs, zeroes their last-Linear weights when not training, and registers the persistent state_code buffer for cross-tick EMA.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: MECH-261-gated EMA update of the OFC state code from projected z_world (and optional pooled z_harm) with the effective learning rate scaled by the SalienceCoordinator write gate.

nodes.name: compute_bias
nodes.summary: Concatenates the persistent state code with per-candidate z_world summaries and returns a clamped per-candidate scalar bias for E3 score composition, caching the mean-abs magnitude for diagnostics.

nodes.name: compute_devaluation_bias
nodes.summary: Emits a per-candidate bias from the decoupled devaluation head clamped to devaluation_bias_scale so that outcome revaluation can shift ranking beyond the primary bias-head clamp band.

nodes.name: query_outcome
nodes.summary: MECH-263 outcome-oracle path that runs the caller-supplied E2 harm-forward model under no_grad on detached inputs and caches the last prediction for diagnostics.

nodes.name: get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a diagnostics dict exposing state-code norm, last bias magnitudes, and oracle readiness/prediction stats used by experiment manifests and downstream governance readouts.

nodes.name: e1_deep.py
nodes.summary: E1 deep long-horizon predictor built on an LSTM over the latent stack with a cue-indexed ContextMemory (SD-016) for schema readout, cue-action bias generation, and SHY-style synaptic homeostasis for MECH-120.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SD-016 sd_016_attention_scale and a Sigmoid schema readout head; supports GRU/LSTM RNN backends via getattr.

nodes.name: ContextMemory
nodes.summary: Slot-based attentional key/value memory with a scalar write gate, providing read(query), gated write(signal), and an off-diagonal cosine diversification loss used by SD-016 Path 1.

nodes.name: E1DeepPredictor
nodes.summary: Long-horizon E1 predictor coordinating a ContextMemory-conditioned prior, LSTM/GRU rollouts, SD-016 cue-action and terrain-weight readouts, MECH-216 schema salience, MECH-120 SHY normalisation, and experience integration losses.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Wires the ContextMemory, transition RNN, prior generator, output projection, optional SD-016 cue projections, MECH-216 schema readout head, and SD-016 attention temperature parameter based on E1Config toggles.

nodes.name: predict_long_horizon
nodes.summary: Rolls the transition RNN forward `horizon` steps starting from a ContextMemory-conditioned prior, feeding predicted states back autoregressively and returning stacked predictions plus optional schema readouts.

nodes.name: extract_cue_context
nodes.summary: SD-016 Path 1/3 cue extraction: either a feed-forward slot tagger or z_world attention over ContextMemory keys produces cue_context, then projects to cue_action bias and cue_terrain (harm, goal) weights fed to E3.

nodes.name: compute_attention_entropy_loss
nodes.summary: Computes the negative Shannon entropy over the SD-016 attention weights from a z_world query, giving a loss term that pushes cue-context attention toward selectivity.

nodes.name: update_from_observation
nodes.summary: Writes an observed latent into ContextMemory and returns the mean-squared prediction error for external logging and adaptive triggers.

nodes.name: integrate_experience
nodes.summary: Samples random windows from an experience buffer and trains E1 by matching predict_long_horizon output against ground-truth latents via MSE, returning the mean loss across sampled epochs.

nodes.name: forward
nodes.summary: Convenience nn.Module forward: expands z_goal across the batch, projects it through goal_input_proj, concatenates with input state, and dispatches to predict_long_horizon and generate_prior.

nodes.name: dacc.py
nodes.summary: Implements the SD-032b dACC/aMCC-analog adaptive control module -- computes precision-weighted affective prediction error (MECH-258), Shenhav-EVC per-candidate expected value, Croxson-style reward/effort interaction, Kolling foraging signal, and MECH-260 recency-suppression, then converts the integration bundle into an E3 score bias via a stopgap adapter pending the SD-032a salience-network coordinator.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-trainable nn.Module used as a control-plane arithmetic regulator; float scalars mixed with torch tensors; heavy inline docstrings encode MECH claim provenance and SD-034 closure-operator hooks.

nodes.name: DACCConfig
nodes.summary: Frozen-form dataclass carrying all sub-weights, precision/effort constants, MECH-268 saturation knobs, SD-034 pe_cap hook, and SD-057 L7 goal-readout controls for the dACC adaptive-control cluster; every knob defaults to zero/false so the module is no-op unless explicitly activated via REEConfig.use_dacc.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl
nodes.summary: Stateful non-trainable dACC/aMCC-analog module that integrates precision-weighted affective PE (MECH-258), Shenhav EVC per-candidate expected value, Croxson reward-x-effort interaction, Kolling foraging value, MECH-260 recency suppression, MECH-268 outcome-history saturation, and Scholl 2017 drive-gated coupling into a per-tick control-plane bundle.

nodes.name: DACCtoE3Adapter
nodes.summary: Stopgap adapter converting a DACCAdaptiveControl integration bundle into an additive per-candidate E3 score bias with an absolute clamp and an independent SD-057 L7 (MECH-348) object-discriminative goal-readout term; to be removed once SD-032a salience-network coordinator lands.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.__init__
nodes.summary: Initialises the dACC module's per-episode state: PE EMA slot, action-history ring for MECH-260, outcome-history FIFO for MECH-268 saturation, and per-tick diagnostic slots used by experiment scripts.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl._affective_pe
nodes.summary: MECH-258 precision-weighted affective prediction error pipeline: forms ||z_harm_a - z_harm_a_pred||, applies precision-normalised gain, clamps to SD-034 dacc_pe_cap, then attenuates by the MECH-268 history-conditioned saturation factor for the current outcome class.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl._saturation_factor
nodes.summary: MECH-268 f_sat computation: counts recurrences of the current outcome class within the recent outcome-history window and returns a habituation multiplier plus the recurrence count, returning 1.0 when saturation is disabled or the class cannot be determined.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.record_outcome
nodes.summary: Pushes an outcome class onto the MECH-268 saturation FIFO with a bounded double-window buffer; ClosureOperator clears this on rule-completion firing.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl._suppression_penalty
nodes.summary: MECH-260 per-candidate recency penalty: fraction of the recent action-history ring occupied by the queried action class, used to suppress monostrategy re-selection.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.inject_nogo
nodes.summary: SD-034 targeted No-Go: injects a completed action class into the MECH-260 recency ring multiple times to bias the striatum away from re-selection, clipped by history memory.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.forward
nodes.summary: Core per-tick dACC integration: computes precision-weighted PE, Shenhav EVC mode_ev, Croxson reward-x-effort interaction, choice difficulty, MECH-260 per-candidate suppression penalties, Kolling foraging value, SD-049 per-axis drive-gated coupling, and packages the full control-plane bundle including SD-057 L7 goal-readout and MECH-268 saturation diagnostics.

nodes.name: DACCtoE3Adapter.forward
nodes.summary: Converts a DACCAdaptiveControl bundle into a per-candidate E3 score bias by combining -mode_ev, Croxson interaction, Kolling foraging, and MECH-260 suppression terms with drive-gated dacc_weight and an absolute clamp, then adds an independently-weighted SD-057 L7 goal-readout term after the clamp so goal-conditioned bias survives even when the legacy dACC path is off.

nodes.name: goal.py
nodes.summary: z_goal persistent goal representation for REE V3: slow-decay attractor in z_world space, incentive-salience token bank (SD-057), and super-ordinal cross-episode goal-anchor store (MECH-189).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dataclass configs with extensive SD-linked docstring provenance; per-object EMA banks with cross-episode persistence controlled by explicit reset semantics.

nodes.name: GoalConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass parameterizing z_goal attractor dynamics (alpha/decay), drive modulation (SD-012), seeding gates, valence-liking floor, and SD-057 IncentiveTokenBank + MECH-189 SuperOrdinalGoalMemory sub-flags.

nodes.name: SuperOrdinalGoalMemory
nodes.summary: MECH-189 cross-episode cue-indexed goal-anchor store implementing SD-077 common-mode-invariant cue key with centered residual retrieval and reinforce-vs-allocate write policy.

nodes.name: IncentiveTokenBank
nodes.summary: SD-057 per-object incentive-salience token bank; binds benefit to SD-049 resource type, stores per-object base_value + z_object embedding, and computes drive-modulated wanting for cue recall.

nodes.name: GoalState
nodes.summary: Persistent z_goal attractor with EMA update, drive-gated seeding threshold, SD-092 hierarchical parent-goal credit, SD-093 progress-velocity effort modulation, and MECH-188 injection view for scoring.

nodes.name: module.py
nodes.summary: HippocampalModule: navigates action-object space O, generates CEM trajectory proposals with support-preserving diversity, orchestrates anchor sets, V_s vintaging, ghost-goal probes, and policy chunking/decomposition.
nodes.languageNotes: Deep orchestration of MECH-269 anchors, MECH-284 staleness, MECH-292/293 ghost-goal, ARC-070/071 chunking; ARC-007-strict value-flat proposals with no internal value head.

nodes.name: HippocampalModule
nodes.summary: Central hippocampal orchestrator: propose_trajectories with CEM + SP-CEM elite selection, per-stream/per-region V_s (MECH-269), anchor-set + broadcast triggers, ghost-goal probes, policy chunking/decomposition splicing.

nodes.name: serotonin.py
nodes.summary: SerotoninModule: MECH-203/204 tonic-5HT state variable + benefit/harm salience tagging, phase-dependent dynamics (waking rise/REM quiescence), and dynamic GoalConfig modulation for balanced replay prioritisation.

nodes.name: SerotoninConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass for SerotoninModule dynamics: baseline, benefit sensitivity, harm suppression, decay rate, phase-specific factors, plus SR-2/SR-3 gains and MECH-204 REM recalibration knobs.

nodes.name: SerotoninModule
nodes.summary: Tonic-5HT scalar state machine with per-phase step dynamics, benefit/harm salience tags (SR-2), REM zero-point capture (SR-3), and MECH-204 target precision recalibration.

nodes.name: e3_selector.py
nodes.summary: E3 trajectory selector: scores candidates via harm/goal/residue costs, hosts ARC-016 dynamic-precision commit gate, F-eligibility demotion (MECH-448), Go/No-Go constitution (MECH-449), learned-gating (ARC-108), MECH-450 settling, ARC-110 loop segregation.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive score_bias composition chain from many upstream modulators; conflict-graded shortlist-then-modulate arbitration under strict eligible-set safety.

nodes.name: project_channel_range
nodes.summary: Range-preserving projection of a per-candidate channel representation to a per-candidate scalar bias; SVD-based leading singular direction for [K,D], identity for [K], zero for degenerate/flat inputs.

nodes.name: variance_commit_threshold
nodes.summary: Helper computing the ARC-016 effective commit threshold from base commit variance and current running-variance dynamics.

nodes.name: SelectionResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding an E3.select() outcome: selected action tensor, softmax probabilities, chosen candidate index, per-candidate scores, and commit/urgency signals.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector
nodes.summary: Ethics-engine 3 selector: harm/goal/benefit scoring heads, dynamic-precision commit gate, F-eligibility demotion + Go/No-Go, learned-gating three-factor plasticity, loop segregation, per-candidate soft-competitive settling.

nodes.name: field.py
nodes.summary: ResidueField: RBF-based accumulator over world_delta (z_world) with SD-014 four-component valence vectors (wanting/liking/harm/surprise), safety terrain (SD-052), benefit terrain (SD-024), and DA-modulated cluster allocation.
nodes.languageNotes: Sparse active-center pool, MECH-094-gated writes via hypothesis_tag, and multiplicative discharge with sign-aware floor preserving invariants.

nodes.name: RBFLayer
nodes.summary: Radial-basis-function layer holding centers, weights, per-center bandwidth, and 6-dim valence_vecs; supports single-center add, DA-modulated cluster allocation, and weight-independent local density.

nodes.name: ResidueField
nodes.summary: Multi-field accumulator: main residue RBF, safety terrain, benefit terrain, per-object VALENCE_WANTING sensitisation, EWC anchor for SD-034 discharge; hypothesis_tag-gated updates enforce MECH-094.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Central REE configuration surface: dataclass configs for every substrate (latent stack, E1/E2/E3, hippocampal, residue, heartbeat, environment) plus REEConfig aggregator with from_dims factory that resolves cross-cutting master switches.
nodes.languageNotes: Enormous dataclass surface (6778 lines) with three-site pattern (dataclass field / from_dims signature / assignment); post_init resolvers for master switches (MECH-090, MECH-307, sleep aggregation).

nodes.name: LatentStackConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the shared latent stack: dimensions for z_self/z_world/z_beta/z_theta/z_delta, encoder toggles, resource encoder, harm-encoder streams, DR-13 self-recurrence, and MECH-269b V_s rollout gating knobs.

nodes.name: E1Config
nodes.summary: E1 (LSTM prediction) config: hidden dim, context memory slots, SD-016 frontal cue-integration projections, schema wanting readout, MECH-423 iterative-inference settling.

nodes.name: E2Config
nodes.summary: E2 (fast forward model) config: action encoding dim, hidden dim, rollout length, SD-056 action-conditional contrastive divergence knobs, cross-stream binding, rollout-norm clamp.

nodes.name: E3Config

nodes.name: structured_curiosity.py
nodes.summary: Pure-arithmetic MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus regulator combining novelty (314a), uncertainty (314b), and learning-progress (314c) sub-flavors into a per-candidate E3 score bias with auto-augmentation streak tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Sibling-pattern regulator (no nn.Module, no learned params) exposing three independently-togglable sub-flavours for Q-044 ablation; MECH-094 simulation-mode gated.

nodes.name: StructuredCuriosityConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding MECH-314 curiosity master switch, three sub-flavour flags, per-flavour weights, clamp scale, LP EMA/window parameters, and Phase-2 novelty auto-augmentation controls.

nodes.name: StructuredCuriosity
nodes.summary: Pure-arithmetic curiosity regulator that composes MECH-314a novelty, MECH-314b uncertainty, and MECH-314c learning-progress into a clamped per-candidate score bias, honoring MECH-094 simulation-mode gating and tracking auto-augmentation streaks.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-nn.Module regulator with three orthogonally-toggleable channels; state is scalars/ring buffers only; broadcast Phase-1 for 314b/c with per-candidate 314a.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Validates all StructuredCuriosityConfig sub-flags, weights, gains, thresholds, and window sizes; raises ValueError on any invalid setting before initializing counters and LP ring buffer.

nodes.name: compute_score_bias
nodes.summary: Main per-tick entry point that dispatches to Phase-2 novelty when enabled, composes weighted MECH-314a/b/c contributions into a K-length bias vector, clamps to +/-bias_scale, and records diagnostic ranges and rail hits.

nodes.name: _compute_novelty_phase2
nodes.summary: Phase-2 novelty computation that consumes coerced RBF centers, monitors candidate spread against the min-spread threshold, updates auto-augmentation streaks, and toggles first-action one-hot augmentation when the streak triggers.

nodes.name: _candidate_spread
nodes.summary: Computes mean pairwise L2 distance across K candidate summaries under no_grad as a scalar spread diagnostic feeding the auto-augmentation streak controller.

nodes.name: _update_augmentation_streak
nodes.summary: Advances or resets the consecutive-low-spread streak counter, flipping first-action one-hot augmentation on when the streak crosses the configured tick threshold.

nodes.name: _coerce_source_to_centers
nodes.summary: Normalizes heterogeneous novelty-source inputs (lists, tensors, arrays) into a detached [N,D] tensor on the target device for Phase-2 novelty processing.

nodes.name: _compute_novelty
nodes.summary: MECH-314a per-candidate novelty via minimum distance from each candidate's first-step z_world to the nearest active RBF center, optionally augmented with first-action one-hots, normalized by mean signature norm.

nodes.name: _compute_uncertainty
nodes.summary: MECH-314b uncertainty scalar read from E3 running variance, broadcast in Phase-1 across candidates and normalized to a nonnegative float.

nodes.name: update_prediction_error
nodes.summary: Feeds a per-tick prediction-error scalar into the MECH-314c learning-progress ring buffer and refreshes the LP EMA of |PE_t - PE_{t-K}|, gated by simulation_mode to protect replay paths.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Clears LP ring buffer, EMA state, augmentation streak/state, and per-tick diagnostic counters on episode reset.

nodes.name: get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a diagnostic dict of curiosity state including LP buffer size, EMA value, augmentation streak, and per-flavour contribution ranges for downstream logging and Q-044 ablation checks.

nodes.name: causal_grid_world.py
nodes.summary: Massive gridworld simulation environment (CausalGridWorld / CausalGridWorldV2) providing the core embodied task substrate for V3 experiments — implements agent step/reset dynamics, resource and hazard fields, microhabitat zones, weather and drift, interoceptive noise, effort dissociation, safety cues, scheduled limb damage, and rich structured observations.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 5196-line module carrying most experimental environmental variation; near-monolithic design where __init__ (1239 lines) parses hundreds of kwargs and step (1221 lines) sequences every per-tick subsystem — the size is intentional to keep experimental knobs colocated for reproducibility.

nodes.name: CausalGridWorld
nodes.summary: Primary embodied gridworld environment: an agent navigates a discretized world of resource, hazard, waypoint and landmark cells with configurable microhabitat zones, weather/drift dynamics, interoceptive noise, effort cost dynamics, and structured multi-modal observations for the REE V3 substrate.
nodes.languageNotes: 63 methods, ~5000 lines; effectively the union of many experiment-specific behaviours, gated by kwargs consumed in __init__.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Enormous constructor that parses several hundred experimental kwargs, initialises the grid, places resources/hazards/landmarks/waypoints/reef patches, builds microhabitat zones and bipartite pools, seeds multi-source and weather-field state, and configures effort/interoceptive/safety-cue subsystems.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Episode reset: reinitialises agent position, per-episode telemetry, effort state, drift/weather state, and re-randomises stochastic layout elements per the configured regime.

nodes.name: reset_to
nodes.summary: Deterministic reset to a caller-supplied state snapshot (positions, fields, telemetry) used by evaluation and diagnostic harnesses that need reproducible replay.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: Per-tick transition function: applies the chosen action, moves the agent, resolves resource consumption and hazard contact, ticks weather/drift/transient events, updates effort/interoceptive state, computes reward and terminations, and returns the next observation dict.

nodes.name: _get_observation_dict
nodes.summary: Assembles the structured observation dictionary each tick — agent pose, interoceptive channels, resource/hazard/landmark fields, zone descriptors, weather field, safety cues and telemetry — the canonical input to REE V3 predictors.

nodes.name: _apply_interoceptive_noise
nodes.summary: Perturbs interoceptive readings (energy, damage, thirst-like channels) with configurable noise schedules — central to experiments probing internal-state ambiguity and salience/precision.

nodes.name: _apply_effort_dissociation_layout
nodes.summary: Reshapes the resource/effort corridor layout for effort-vs-reward dissociation experiments (Q-080 lineage), so effort cost and reward gradient can be independently manipulated.

nodes.name: _effort_cost_by_action
nodes.summary: Computes the per-action effort cost given the current cell, corridor, and dissociation regime; drives interoceptive-energy depletion.

nodes.name: _consume_resource_at
nodes.summary: Handles a consume action at a resource cell — decrements the local stock, delivers reward, updates telemetry, and triggers respawn scheduling per the resource's regime.

nodes.name: _maybe_shift_world_rule
nodes.summary: Non-stationarity hook — probabilistically swaps the active world rule at reset (e.g. inverts resource/hazard mapping) to test transfer and re-learning.

nodes.name: _place_random_landmarks
nodes.summary: Scatters landmark cells uniformly at random for spatial-cue baseline conditions.

nodes.name: _place_biased_near_resources
nodes.summary: Places landmarks with spatial bias toward resource cells, producing predictive-cue structure for landmark-following experiments.

nodes.name: _compute_landmark_field
nodes.summary: Computes a scalar landmark-proximity field over the grid from placed landmark cells.

nodes.name: _place_reef_patches
nodes.summary: Places contiguous reef-patch clusters (structured resource aggregations) with configurable size and density.

nodes.name: _place_reef_patches_bipartite
nodes.summary: Bipartite variant of reef-patch placement that separates the grid into two halves with distinct patch statistics — supports habitat-choice paradigms.

nodes.name: _build_microhabitat_zones
nodes.summary: Constructs the microhabitat zone partition of the grid — each zone carries its own resource/hazard modifiers used throughout step().

nodes.name: _draw_microhabitat_zone_map
nodes.summary: Rasterises the microhabitat zone assignment into a 2-D map suitable for observation encoding and telemetry.

nodes.name: _build_bipartite_pools
nodes.summary: Builds the two per-half candidate-cell pools that drive bipartite habitat variants of resource/hazard placement.

nodes.name: _compute_proximity_fields
nodes.summary: Recomputes per-cell proximity fields to resources and hazards used by both observations and shaping signals.

nodes.name: _init_multi_source_state
nodes.summary: Initialises state for multi-source weather/drift fields — the seed positions, phases, and per-source parameters used by _step_weather_field.

nodes.name: _step_weather_field
nodes.summary: Advances the spatially-varying weather field one tick — moves sources, updates amplitudes, and re-derives per-cell weather values.

nodes.name: _step_transient_events
nodes.summary: Ticks any scheduled transient events (short-lived benefits, hazard bursts, weather spikes) toward expiry and injects new ones per their schedules.

nodes.name: _step_background_drift
nodes.summary: Applies slow background drift to resource, hazard, and landmark fields — creates gradual non-stationarity distinct from the discrete rule-shift path.

nodes.name: _inject_external_hazard
nodes.summary: Injects an exogenously-scheduled hazard event at a targeted cell/region, used by causal-perturbation and safety-cue experiments.

nodes.name: set_safety_cue
nodes.summary: Public setter for the safety-cue channel — external drivers use this to condition the agent's environment on a signal predicting impending hazard.

nodes.name: _inject_scheduled_limb_damage
nodes.summary: Applies a scheduled limb-damage event (random or all-limb selection) — degrades action fidelity to probe recovery and compensation.

nodes.name: _inject_counter_evidence
nodes.summary: Injects observations that contradict a currently-held rule model — used in belief-revision and confirmation-bias experiments.

nodes.name: _drift_hazards
nodes.summary: Advances hazard positions/intensities per their drift schedule, distinct from generic background drift.

nodes.name: _respawn_resource
nodes.summary: Respawns a consumed resource cell after its cooldown expires per the configured respawn regime.

nodes.name: _spawn_transient_benefit
nodes.summary: Instantiates a short-lived beneficial cell (e.g., temporary reward or safety spot) with sampled position and lifetime.

nodes.name: _respawn_waypoints
nodes.summary: Restocks waypoint cells when the episode's waypoint budget allows, driving multi-goal navigation regimes.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Produces a textual/matplotlib-friendly rendering of the current world state — grid cells, agent position, hazards, resources — for debugging and evidence visualisations.

nodes.name: world_obs_dim
nodes.summary: Reports the flattened dimensionality of the world (exteroceptive) observation vector, taking into account which optional channels are enabled by config.

nodes.name: action_dim
nodes.summary: Returns the size of the discrete action set (movement primitives plus consume), factoring in optional action-space extensions.

nodes.name: _compute_traj_cosine_mean
nodes.summary: Computes the mean cosine similarity across recent trajectory windows — a movement-consistency telemetry used by exploration analyses.

nodes.name: _zone_coverage
nodes.summary: Computes the fraction of microhabitat zones visited by the agent this episode — coverage telemetry used by exploration/exploitation diagnostics.

nodes.name: _pos_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes the entropy of the agent's position distribution across the episode — an exploration-diversity telemetry.

nodes.name: CausalGridWorldV2
nodes.summary: Module-level factory returning a CausalGridWorld configured with the V2 experimental defaults — provides a stable alias so V2 experiments do not carry every knob explicitly.
